memberdef.name: DXIL_OP_FUNCTION_TYPE
DXIL_OP_ATTRIBUTES

detaileddescription.para: This is the type of a function with the following prototype OverloadType dx.op.<opclass>.<return-type>(int opcode, ) <param-types> are constructed from types in Prop.

briefdescription.para: Get index of the property from PropList valid for the most recent DXIL version not greater than DXILVer.

detaileddescription.para: PropList is expected to be sorted in ascending order of DXIL version.
